correctness.rationale: The fixed cycle makes any invariant equivalence a subgroup congruence, so only residues mod 3 are proper and nontrivial. If b preserves this partition, rank 7 is too large for the quotient to use only two target blocks, so both letters permute the quotient and no reset exists. For the converse an independent non-enumerative proof replaces the decisive census check. Let r be the least word rank, choose an image C of size r, and let A be any fiber of any rank-r word f. Distinct points of C cannot be merged by a word, or r would drop; the same is true of every rotation C+t. Hence |(C+t)∩A|≤1. Summing over rotations gives r|A|≤9, and all r fibers together have size 9, so all have size 9/r. Since 1<r≤7 in the nonsynchronizing case, r=3. Writing w(x)=|b⁻¹(x)|, each translated fiber A+t has b-preimage size 3: apply b, rotate by −t, then apply f; the result still has rank 3 and uniformly sized fibers. Multiply Σ_{x∈A+t}w(x)=3 by ζ^t and sum over t for a primitive ninth root ζ. The result is (Σ_x w(x)ζ^x)(Σ_{a∈A}ζ^(−a))=0. A rational polynomial of degree at most 8 vanishing at ζ or ζ⁻¹ is divisible by Φ₉(z)=1+z³+z⁶ with quotient of degree at most 2; its coefficient vector is therefore constant on residues mod 3. The first factor cannot vanish because w has support 7, not a multiple of 3. Each A must thus be a full residue class. Apply this to f and f∘b, both rank 3: b takes each mod-3 class into a single mod-3 class. This proves the exact converse for both kernel shapes without relying on running the supplied census. Independently, there are 84+378 partitions with the two kernel shapes and 9!/2! image assignments per partition, yielding 83,825,280. A quotient permutation has six choices, and each class has 3,18,6 maps of local rank 1,2,3, respectively, allowing profiles (1,3,3) and (2,2,3) and their permutations. This gives 1,944+34,992=36,936 obstructions and 83,788,344 synchronizing maps. No nonidentity rotation can stabilize an image of size 7 because its orbit lengths are divisible by 3; division by 9 gives 9,313,920 total classes and 4,104 nonsynchronizing classes. Both C++ census programs and COUNTS.txt were inspected, not executed. The base-nine code exhausts transition tables and closes the four nonzero distance classes, whose rotations parametrize all pairs; the other generates kernel partitions with each ordered image injection once and closes backwards from direct collisions on all 36 pairs. The subset script's full checks at orders 4–6 and sampled checks at order 9 are supplementary and not the converse.

evidence: Primitive permutation groups synchronize maps of rank n−2 by Araújo et al.; the unit group here is exactly the imprimitive C₉ since every word using b has rank at most 7.
Volkov's primitive DFA theorem applies with a unimodal letter and in particular a single nonsingleton kernel class. His defect-one corollary concerns rank 8 here.
Pin's positive prime-cycle result reported by Rystsov–Szykuła excludes composite degree nine. Their five-state defect-two example shows that monoid primitivity by itself does not suffice in general.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The plausible dominating rank-n−2 theorem has the wrong permutation-group hypothesis, even when the transition monoid is primitive. The prime-cycle and one-fiber theorems are genuine nearby results, but neither covers the arbitrary double-pair letter considered here.

value.rationale: Degree nine is the first odd composite cyclic degree and has exactly one potential proper congruence. Defect two is the first defect where two nontrivial kernel fibers can occur and the broad one-exceptional-fiber criterion no longer suffices. Pinning down the complete modular obstruction and both exact kernel-shape populations gives a motivated boundary case and reproducible benchmark for circular synchronization, not a randomly selected number of states or mere reset-length tabulation.
